source: Independent read-only review of the prior Architect findings, correction report, revision-2 spec, plan, test specification, and graph.

evidence: The spec makes CDP and page snapshots metadata-only and forbids input/textarea value fields before and after fill.
G007 owns magic-browser/src/runtime/cdp.ts and typed-tools.ts plus the pre-fill and post-fill open_snapshot regression tests.
The test spec requires value absence before any Padloc privacy-status check and covers open_snapshot and compact snapshots.
The spec assigns privacy-status production to the Padloc observation ledger and defines unknown, clean, potentially-private, navigation, tab-close, and trusted-reset transitions.
G005 owns the privacy state producer and autofill-observation-reset; the reset is exact-target and cannot clean a private-written document.
G005 and G007 tests cover reset, navigation, new-document, tab-close, unknown, and private blocking.
privacy-status.v2 echoes tabId, frameId, origin, documentId, formRef, targetRevision, and sessionId.
The plan and tests reject active-tab substitution and cross-tab, frame, document, form, and target-revision mismatches.
Protocol-v1 responses without target identity remain readable only as non-authorizing data.
G001 owns the shared ImportProvenance and ImportResult core contract, persisted VaultItem provenance, createItem, and template propagation.
G002 consumes that contract from the 1PUX parser/importer and returns exact imported, normalized, skipped, and lossy counts with loss entries.
The test spec forbids a parallel report channel and covers unsupported categories without real values.
The compatibility path is an EncryptedAutofillProfileEnvelope with opaque ciphertext and one-time wrapped-key custody.
G005 owns the trusted receiver; G006 owns the local-vault adapter and transport, with explicit no-plaintext and no-fill-grant boundaries.
Negative tests reject plaintext, raw keys, unavailable custody, and migration responses containing a grant.
G003 owns the named passkey background region and lists its exact passkey symbols.
G005 owns only the autofill background region, excludes the passkey region, and depends serially on G003.
The handoff fixture and passkey regression proof are explicitly required before G005 ownership begins.
The spec defines PadlocBrokerResponse as a discriminated closed schema with deny-by-default unknown-key rejection.
G006 owns padloc-broker.ts and its closed parser; tests reject unknown top-level and nested keys, arbitrary names, arrays, and malformed payloads.
Protocol-v1 fields remain readable while incompatible changes require a new protocol version.
G001 owns CreateItemDialog and createItem, and the corrected contract requires template metadata propagation plus conservative derivation when omitted.
The plan connects item kind, roles, provenance, and release class for newly created records.
Creation-path tests cover login, government, and financial template semantics without exposing field values.
The graph prefixes every owned path with padloc/ or magic-browser/.
G009 stores its shared run artifact under padloc/.ch5/autopilot/agentic-autofill-unification-20260918/synthetic-e2e/.
Candidate validation and the test specification reject unprefixed, absolute, and traversal paths.

rationale: All A1-A9 corrections are explicit in the revision-2 contracts, mapped to executable owners and tests, and represented in a valid repository-prefixed DAG with disjoint parallel ownership. Implementation and runtime proof remain pending and are not implied by this approval.
nextGate: Proceed to plan-consensus and implementation dispatch; retain runtime proof as UNKNOWN until G009 executes.
